F0 y F1: plan, documentación y núcleo de.subject: F0 and F1: plan, documentation and terminal core
F0 y F1: plan, documentación y núcleo de.body:
- Plan with an addendum on the home setup, regenerable PDFs and the process Report.
- Tauri 2 + Vite + SolidJS + xterm.js 6 (WebGL with DOM fallback).
- ConPTY sessions with output batching (4 ms / 64 KB), backpressure and a binary channel.
- Profiles: Windows PowerShell, PowerShell 7, cmd, Git Bash and WSL, with detection.
- Copy/paste like Windows Terminal, resize, restart when the shell exits.
- Microsoft's ConPTY (conpty.dll + OpenConsole.exe 1.25, MIT) next to the exe.
- Tests: 9 Rust (including real ConPTY) and 8 Vitest; benchmarks ignored.

F2: pestañas, splits, multi-ventana y sh.subject: F2: tabs, splits, multiple windows and shell integration
F2: pestañas, splits, multi-ventana y sh.body:
- Pure model of tabs and panes (split, close, ratios, neighbors by direction).
- Panes positioned by rectangles and iterated by id: splitting doesn't remount terminals.
- Hidden tabs without WebGL (context limit); they keep loading their buffer.
- Tab bar on top or on the left, marquee, reorder, rename, status.
- Multiple windows: each session belongs to its window and dies with it.
- Shortcuts without Ctrl+Alt (AltGr on Spanish keyboards).
- Shell integration: PowerShell (-EncodedCommand), Git Bash (--init-file) and cmd (PROMPT): OSC 133/633/7/9, marks by exit code, jump between commands, copy the last output.
- Summary title: manual > program's OSC title > command + folder + git branch.
- Fix: writes to the PTY go in order (WriteQueue); keystrokes used to get swapped.
- Tests: Rust 17 (including real PowerShell and Git Bash), Vitest 32.

F3: configuración y temas en vivo.subject: F3: settings and live themes
F3: configuración y temas en vivo.body:
- settings.json in %APPDATA%\NovaTerm: atomic writes, watched for manual edits, .bak copy before overwriting a broken file, notice to every window.
- Settings window (Ctrl+,): 11 themes, dark/light/follow Windows mode, color editor, import themes from Windows Terminal, iTerm2 and xterm.js.
- Background: Mica, Acrylic, opacity and image (transparent windows).
- Installed monospace fonts, ligatures (font read from the backend), cursor.
- Configurable shortcuts with conflict detection, rejecting Ctrl+Alt (AltGr).
- Tests: Rust 24, Vitest 51.

F4: panel de agentes (catálogo editable,.subject: F4: agents panel (editable catalog, detection, launch in a tab, status)
F4: panel de agentes (catálogo editable,.body:
- Detection without running anything: process PATH + registry PATH + usual folders.
- Launch: new tab with the default shell; the command is typed at the first prompt, with the full PATH and the agent's variables.
- Status per agent: starting, working, waiting for input (silence), needs you (bell), finished (with exit code). Also on the tab's dot.
- Panel bar on the right (Ctrl+Shift+A) and dialog plugin to pick a folder.
- Fix: the terminal size is sent again if it changed while the session was starting.

F5: widget de CPU/RAM y footer de consum.subject: F5: CPU/RAM widget and usage footer (Claude, Codex, agy)
F5: widget de CPU/RAM y footer de consum.body:
- CPU and RAM with a 60 s sparkline; click: top processes and usage per tab (the shell's process tree).
- Usage: Claude from Claude Code's statusline (exact) or estimated from transcripts; Codex from its sessions (.jsonl.zst, with ruzstd); agy with the official /quota, no shell. Each figure states its source, whether it's exact and its age; shared 30 s cache.
- Button to install NovaTerm's statusline in Claude Code (with a backup of settings.json).
- Usage and widgets section in Settings.

F6: panel de servidores y puertos (lista.subject: F6: servers and ports panel (list, stop, recipes, start)
F6: panel de servidores y puertos (lista.body:
- Listening ports (IPv4/IPv6) via GetExtendedTcpTable, with process, command, folder and uptime.
- Marks the ones born in a NovaTerm tab (descendants of its shells).
- Stop: taskkill /T /F, with a stronger confirmation if NovaTerm didn't launch it; never PID <= 4.
- Recipes: saved automatically (command via OSC 633 + folder + ports) or by hand; Start opens a background tab; Restart = stop + start. Clickable ports open the browser.

F7: panel de proyectos con árbol que res.subject: F7: projects panel with a tree that respects .gitignore and updates itself
F7: panel de proyectos con árbol que res.body:
- Discovers projects from Claude Code sessions (cwd of the transcripts) and Codex sessions (session_meta, also .jsonl.zst), plus the ones added by hand and recent folders.
- Lazy tree with the ignore crate (.gitignore, global ones and those from parent folders); notify watches the open folders and tells the window to reload them.
- Actions: terminal, launch an agent, Explorer, VS Code, git, hide.

F8: panel de git (status, diff, stage, c.subject: F8: Git panel (status, diff, stage, commit, history, branches, fetch/pull/push, clone, init)
F8: panel de git (status, diff, stage, c.body:
- git CLI with no console or prompts (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0), timeouts, paths with ñ unescaped.
- Porcelain v2 status (renames, conflicts, untracked), unified or side-by-side diff, stage/unstage per file or all, commit with Ctrl+Enter, history with graph and git show, local and remote branches, create and switch, fetch/pull --ff-only/push (with -u if there's no upstream).
- Change counter on each tab; resizable side panel.
- End-to-end test in a temporary repo.

Renombrar a AlphaTerm.subject: Rename to AlphaTerm
Renombrar a AlphaTerm.body:
- Product, binary (alphaterm.exe), identifier (uy.alphaterm.app), TERM_PROGRAM variables and integration scripts. Saved theme ids don't change.
- Settings move to %APPDATA%\AlphaTerm: the first time, NovaTerm's are copied (without deleting them).

Rutas en la terminal: links que abren ca.subject: Paths in the terminal: links that open a folder or file, with preview (image, text, folder)

Pestañas con color y carpetas, título de.subject: Tab colors and groups, manual window title and session restore on open
Pestañas con color y carpetas, título de.body:
- Tab context menu: rename, color, group (new, move, remove), window title.
- Collapsible tab groups, with color; dropping a tab on a group puts it inside.
- Ctrl+Shift+F2: fixed window title.
- Session in %APPDATA%\AlphaTerm\session.json: tabs, panes with their current folder, colors, groups, title and panel; reopens every window. Agents: relaunching with --continue is optional.

Historial de comandos, ubicación actual.subject: Command history, current location and usage of the open agent
Historial de comandos, ubicación actual.body:
- Persistent global history (history.jsonl, 5000), searchable by words; click types it into the active terminal, double click runs it (Ctrl+Shift+H).
- Footer with the active pane's location (each segment opens that folder, copy path, git branch).
- The usage of the active tab's agent comes first and highlighted; click: details with every usage window, resets, source and a refresh button.
- The terminal exposes sending text and reading its buffer / the last command's output.

Consumo: separar rutas con barra inverti.subject: Usage: split paths on backslashes when recognizing the agent

API de control para agentes, panel de Do.subject: Control API for agents, Docker panel and file Guardian
API de control para agentes, panel de Do.body:
- Local API (127.0.0.1 + a token that changes on every start, control.json and ALPHATERM_* variables in each tab): list, read, last_output, run (waits for it to finish and returns output and exit code), send, open_tab, split, open_window (child windows), close, focus and docker_*.
- alphaterm-mcp.mjs: MCP server and CLI with no dependencies; Claude Code launched from AlphaTerm gets it with --mcp-config.
- Docker: engine status (open Docker Desktop), containers with clickable ports, start, stop, restart, logs and shell in a tab, delete with confirmation, and one-click recipes (Postgres, Redis, MySQL, Mongo, nginx templates) with no shell in between.
- Guardian: asks before deleting or modifying. PreToolUse hook for Claude Code (--settings), Codex with its approval mode, and classified API commands (rm, Remove-Item, git reset --hard, redirections, docker rm…). Dialog in every window, allow 30 min per session, blocks after 10 min without an answer, decision log; turned off in Settings.

F9 (parte): resumen de pestañas con mode.subject: F9 (part): tab summaries with an optional model, About section and limits, startup mark
F9 (parte): resumen de pestañas con mode.body:
- llm_summarize: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama/vLLM/LM Studio), reqwest with the system's TLS, clean title of 2 to 6 words; order: manual > program's OSC > model > heuristic.
- bench_mark: ms from process start to the first prompt (ALPHATERM_BENCH).

Footer de consumo: el efecto de carga en.subject: Usage footer: the load effect looped (renderer 180 MB, 60 layouts per second)
Footer de consumo: el efecto de carga en.body: load() read busy() inside the effect: every load triggered it again. With untrack the renderer drops to ~45 MB and the total with one tab to ~225 MB.

Paneles en mosaico, saltos al principio/.subject: Tiled panels, jump to top/bottom and visual fixes
Paneles en mosaico, saltos al principio/.body:
- Side panels no longer replace each other: they open below or beside, several at once next to the terminal; adjustable width of each column and height between panels, reorder by dragging the title bar; saved in the session and as a preference.
- Buttons to jump to the top or bottom when the output is long.
- No more light line from xterm's ruler; subtle scrollbar.
- Drawn and centered + button; CPU and RAM in a row below the icons in the vertical bar; active button fully lit (panel bar and settings).
- API: integration from the first prompt, read up to the cursor line; the tab menu applies the action before closing (color and group weren't applied).
- Code guide (txt + PDF), AlphaTerm addendum in the plan, regenerated PDFs.

Las shells no heredan el entorno de quie.subject: Shells don't inherit the environment of whoever opened AlphaTerm (Claude Code had no colors)
Las shells no heredan el entorno de quie.body:
- pty/env.rs: NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, CLICOLOR, CI, CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_CODE_* / CLAUDE_AGENT_* (with tokens and the child-session marker) are removed when creating the shell, unless they're in Windows' persistent environment.
- build.rs: CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR at run time (not env!()), so it keeps copying the ConPTY if the folder is moved.

0.2.0: consumo en vivo, panel de modific.subject: 0.2.0: live usage, Changes panel, per-version installer
0.2.0: consumo en vivo, panel de modific.body:
- The cmd window that showed up every 10 min was agy's updater, launched by the quota check: agy now runs with AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true (like the System dashboard).
- Live usage like the dashboard (usage_live.rs): on open and every N minutes, claude (/usage) and codex (/status) are opened in a windowless ConPTY and the screen is read with vt100; agy via /quota. The newest figure wins between the query and the files. Plan, model, windows per model, extra usage, "what else is using it" and weekly forecast.
- Agents panel: usage details under each agent.
- Changes panel (changes.rs, Ctrl+Shift+M): what agents change, with or without git, PDFs by their text, unified or side-by-side diff, expand/collapse all, edit and save (keeps encoding and line endings, doesn't overwrite if the file changed). Sources: Claude Code's Pre/PostToolUse hook and a copy + watcher of the tab's folder for any agent.
- RAM as a percentage; in the vertical bar, the graph below the number and, when collapsed, numbers only.
- Collapsible vertical tab bar.
- Paste images: with no text on the clipboard, the image is saved as a PNG and its path is pasted.
- Version in the footer (commit, date and exe path in the tooltip).
- compilar-version.bat + scripts/release.mjs + scripts/instalar.mjs: builds (in target\prueba if the old version is open), installs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AlphaTerm\versiones\<v> and points the "AlphaTerm <v>" desktop shortcut and the taskbar pin there.
- ALPHATERM_DATA_DIR to test a version next to the open one.
- Rust tests: the Windows manifest is embedded by the linker (without it, STATUS_ENTRYPOINT_NOT_FOUND).

Tests: Rust 72 (+6 ignored), Vitest 104.

Barra vertical ajustable y opciones de a.subject: Resizable vertical bar and agent launch options
Barra vertical ajustable y opciones de a.body:
- Drawn collapse button; draggable vertical bar width (160-480 px, double click 220).
- Launch options per agent (model, effort, permissions, session, more options) with the command line that will run; catalog in agentLaunch.ts gathered from the installed --help output, live models (agent_models), conflicts between options, quoting according to the shell; saved per agent.
- The agents panel iterates ids (it no longer loses focus when the settings change).

Tests: Rust 74 (+6 ignored), Vitest 111.

Versiones automáticas y Novedades (chang.subject: Automatic versions and What's new (changelog between versions with their commits)
Versiones automáticas y Novedades (chang.body:
- compilar-version.bat / scripts/release.mjs: bump the version on their own (patch by default, --minor, --major, --misma), commit "Version X" + tag vX, build and install; if something fails, they undo the commit and the tag.
- scripts/changelog.mjs: changelog from git grouped by vX.Y.Z tags in src/generated/changelog.json (runs with dev, build and typecheck). Tags v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 set on their commits.
- Footer: "What's new" button with each version, its date and its commits (body when expanded, hash to copy), "after X up to Y" filter, expand/collapse all and the running version highlighted.

Navegador integrado con marcado de eleme.subject: Built-in browser with element marking to ask the agent for changes
Navegador integrado con marcado de eleme.body:
- Browser panel (child WebView2 inside the window, driven through DevTools): URL, back, forward, reload, console errors; hides under menus and modals and in other tabs.
- Edit mode: highlight on hover, click to mark (several), Alt+click for the parent, "Whole site" for global changes. Each mark carries selector, HTML, styles, position, screenshot and, when possible, the component and its file (React, Vue, Svelte, Angular).
- The request is pasted into the terminal of the tab's agent with the screenshots and a pedido.md; "working… done" with Claude Code's Stop hook (or by silence for other agents), and a reload if the page has no hot reload.
- API and MCP: browser_open/list/navigate/reload/screenshot/snapshot/click/type/key/scroll/eval/console/marks.
- Opens with Ctrl+Shift+U, from Servers or through the API; saved in the session.
- Fix: with a child WebView, the control API, the Guardian and window closing use app.windows() (webview_windows() stopped seeing the window).

Configuración dentro de la misma ventana.subject: Settings inside the same window
Configuración dentro de la misma ventana.body: Opens on top of the tabs and panes (Ctrl+, the gear or the version in the footer) instead of in a separate window; closes with Esc, the × or Ctrl+, and focus goes back to the terminal. While it's open, shortcuts don't touch the tabs behind it and the built-in browser hides.

Soporte para Linux: shells, navegador co.subject: Linux support: shells, browser with WebKitGTK and suggestions in bash, zsh and fish
Soporte para Linux: shells, navegador co.body:
- Terminals on the system's PTY with bash, zsh and fish (integration: folder, exit code and history); the default is the user's shell.
- Built-in browser on WebKitGTK: eval, screenshots, console, clicks and keys, edit mode and the request to the agent.
- Ports, fonts, agents, Git, Docker, the Guardian and live usage working on Linux; data in ~/.config/AlphaTerm.
- Linux paths in the output, the location bar and the suggestions (with a catalog of Linux commands).
- build-release.sh: installs per version in ~/.local/share/AlphaTerm with its menu entry.

Linux: documentación en tres idiomas.subject: Linux: documentation in three languages
Linux: documentación en tres idiomas.body: - README, CLAUDE.md, code guide and process report: how to build and install on Linux, what changes there and how it was tested.

Reordenar pestañas arrastrando, con la b.subject: Reorder tabs by dragging, with the bar on top or on the left
Reordenar pestañas arrastrando, con la b.body:
- Tabs are dragged to change their order, with the bar on top, on the left or collapsed; a line marks where they will land and Esc cancels.
- Tab groups: next to a tab, it joins that tab's group; on a group's header, it goes just before the group or into it (also when collapsed); past the last tab, it's loose at the end.
- With many tabs, the list scrolls by itself near an edge.
